transcript.text: Bosch HBS534BS0B oven displaying E011 and won't let me do anything. Beeping. Help!

I’ve noted the E011 code on your Bosch HBS534BS0B display; this is the right place to start regardless. Many ovens will not heat or respond until the clock is set or manual mode is selected following a power cut. Was the clock flashing or an auto mode set (and have you set it to manual), or was it already set?
No power cut, the clock was showing fine before the code appeared. It started about an hour ago right after I wiped the control panel with a damp cloth and a multi-surface spray.

Thanks for confirming the clock is set. Some ovens have a key or child lock, often marked by a key symbol, which stops them working; your manual will show which button to hold to release it. Was a key lock on (and is it off now), or was there no lock on?
No key lock symbol showing, I don't think a lock is on. Still stuck on E011 with the beeping though. What should I try next?

[Heading: Function selector or control]
Thanks for confirming that. Since the display is on and there is no lock, the issue likely lies with the selector or control unit. This requires an appliance engineer to inspect; I am not recommending you replace any parts at this stage. Please arrange for a qualified professional to attend.
